info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Competitor Analysis API
info.description: The Competitor Analysis API provides insights into the competitive landscape of businesses within the banking sector. By accessing this endpoint, users can retrieve comprehensive analysis data that highlights competitor performance metrics, market trends, and strategic positioning. Typical consumers of this API include business analysts, strategists, and financial institutions seeking to enhance their competitive strategies. This data empowers stakeholders to make informed decisions based on current industry dynamics.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information and insights regarding competitor performance in the market. It provides analytical data that can help inform business strategies and decision-making processes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve data related to competitor analysis in the business analysis module. It should contain the necessary parameters in JSON format required for the operation.

200.description: Successful retrieval of competitor analysis data.

GetCompetitorAnalysisRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the Competitor Analysis operation under Business Analysis. It is expected to be a string containing the relevant data for the analysis.

GetCompetitorAnalysisResponse_200.title: Competitor Analysis Response

items.description: A list of competitor analysis records.

pagination.description: Pagination information for the result set.
